corrections.text: The article credits TechSpot for reporting that signs about the ban went up 'outside the Honorable James C. Torney III Criminal Courthouse in Syracuse.' TechSpot's report does not name this courthouse. The detail is accurate but is sourced to Engadget and GovTech (via Syracuse.com/Anne Hayes), not TechSpot.

The article states the Zuckerberg-trial hearing where a judge warned about smart glasses 'took place on February 19, 2026, according to CBS News.' The CBS News article's own text says the incident happened 'on Wednesday,' and its published/updated timestamps are both February 19, 2026 (a Thursday), indicating the hearing actually occurred on Wednesday, February 18, 2026.
